word: I’m honored to be with you today for your commencement from one of the finest universities in the world.
meaning: 我很榮幸今天能與你們同在，參加你們在世界上最優秀的大學之一的畢業典禮。
example: He says he feels privileged to attend and speak at the graduation ceremony of a top university.
hint:
中文解釋：他先用非常正式、禮貌的方式開場：表達『很榮幸』參與大家的畢業典禮，並稱讚這所學校是世界頂尖之一。

Key terms:
1) honored (adj.): 感到榮幸的；syn: privileged, grateful; ant: ashamed
2) commencement (n.): 畢業典禮；syn: graduation ceremony; ant: (none)
3) finest (adj.): 最好的、最優秀的；syn: best, top; ant: worst
pronunciation: 朗讀提示：commencement 重音在第二音節 /kəˈmensmənt/；one of the finest 這段可連讀成一個語塊。

word: Truth be told, I never graduated from college.
meaning: 說實話，我從來沒有大學畢業。
example: He admits honestly that he did not finish college.
hint:
中文解釋：truth be told 是固定說法，表示『說真的／老實說』，用來引出坦白的內容；這句他直接承認自己其實沒有大學畢業。

Key terms:
1) truth be told (phrase): 說實話；syn: honestly, to be honest; ant: (none)
2) graduated (v., past): 畢業；syn: completed, finished; ant: drop out (of)
3) college (n.): 大學；syn: university (esp. AmE usage differs slightly); ant: (none)
pronunciation: 朗讀提示：Truth be told 常作插入語，語速可稍快、兩側停頓；graduated from /ˈɡrædʒueɪtɪd frəm/ 可弱讀 from。

word: And this is the closest I’ve ever gotten to a college graduation.
meaning: 而這（今天）是我這輩子最接近『大學畢業』的一次。
example: He says this ceremony is the nearest experience he has had to graduating from college.
hint:
中文解釋：closest … to … 表示『最接近……』；I’ve ever gotten 是現在完成式，強調『到目前為止的人生經驗』。他用一點幽默：自己沒畢業，所以站在這裡反而是最像在參加自己的畢業。

Key terms:
1) closest (adj.): 最接近的；syn: nearest; ant: farthest
2) have ever gotten to (phrase): 曾經到達／曾經接近（到目前為止）；syn: have ever come to; ant: (none)
3) graduation (n.): 畢業；syn: commencement; ant: dropout
pronunciation: 朗讀提示：closest 放重音；I’ve ever gotten to 這段通常弱讀、連讀，重點落在 closest 和 graduation。

word: Today I want to tell you three stories from my life.
meaning: 今天我想跟你們分享我人生中的三個故事。
example: He plans to share three personal stories.
hint:
中文解釋：很直白的結構：want to tell you…；from my life 表示故事取材自他的親身經歷。

Key terms:
1) tell (v.): 講述；syn: share, recount; ant: conceal
2) story (n.): 故事；syn: tale, narrative; ant: fact (in contrast)
3) from my life (prep. phrase): 取材自我的人生；syn: from my personal experience; ant: (none)
pronunciation: 朗讀提示：three stories 可稍加重；from my life 輕帶過作收尾。

example: He emphasizes that he will keep it simple and limited.
hint:
中文解釋：口語強調句，用來表示『就到這裡、沒有更多了』，語氣像在說：我不講太多，就三個故事。

Key terms:
1) that’s it (phrase): 就這樣／就是這些；syn: that’s all; ant: (none)
pronunciation: 朗讀提示：短句要乾脆，it 可收尾清楚 /ɪt/ 或自然弱化。

example: He downplays the significance to sound casual.
hint:
中文解釋：口語用法，表示『不算什麼』，他用來讓氣氛更輕鬆，也降低聽眾壓力。

Key terms:
1) big deal (n., informal): 大事、很重要的事；syn: important matter; ant: triviality
2) no big deal (phrase): 沒什麼／不重要；syn: it’s nothing, no problem; ant: a big deal
pronunciation: 朗讀提示：no BIG deal 重音在 big；整句語氣輕鬆即可。

example: He repeats the plan: only three stories.
hint:
中文解釋：just 在這裡是『僅僅』，再次強調內容很精簡。

Key terms:
1) just (adv.): 只是、僅僅；syn: only, merely; ant: exactly (different sense), more than
2) story/stories (n.): 故事；syn: narrative; ant: (none)
pronunciation: 朗讀提示：Just three stories 可當作一個節奏單位，重音在 three。

word: The first story is about connecting the dots.
meaning: 第一個故事要談的是『把點點滴滴連起來』。
example: The first story is about how separate experiences can later make sense as a connected pattern.
hint:
中文解釋：connecting the dots 是比喻：把零散的經歷/選擇在事後看成一條線、一個脈絡。這句是第一段主題句，宣告接下來要講的核心概念。

Key terms:
1) connect (v.): 連結；syn: link, tie; ant: separate
2) dot (n.): 點；（比喻）零散線索；syn: point, clue; ant: (none)
3) connecting the dots (idiom): 把線索串起來／融會貫通；syn: see the bigger picture, make connections; ant: miss the connection
pronunciation: 朗讀提示：first story 重音；connecting the dots 末尾 dots 可清楚收 /ts/。
